name: sound-lab
description: Sound Lab plugins for Claude Code — FFmpeg dubbing, sound design, Whisper/MLX speech and media tooling.

plugins.name: sound-lab-studio
plugins.description: FFmpeg skills, dubbing commands (music beds, live streams, video), procedural SFX, Whisper + MP3/MP4 expert agents, safety hooks, and an MCP server for background batch ffmpeg, MLX speech-to-text/TTS/separation (native Apple GPU, mlx[cuda12] or CPU containers, Apple container) and Docker/Podman runners.
